name: tree-view
description: Hierarchical WAI-ARIA tree: single, multiple or tri-state checkbox selection, lazy children with loading and retry, type-ahead, filtering, guide lines and folder/file icons, and drag-and-drop that also works from the keyboard

changes.note: Additive. data-mode="multiple" (Ctrl/Cmd-click, Shift-click and Shift+Arrow ranges, Ctrl+A) and data-mode="checkbox" (tri-state aria-checked that propagates down to enabled descendants and up as mixed). Lazy items now load: expanding one fires faqir:load (answer with detail.respond(), or register setLoader()), shows aria-busy and a spinner, inserts the children and, on failure, a Retry. A wrapper form adds a filter input, an empty message and a status live region next to the tree part; filtering keeps matches' ancestors open, highlights the match and restores expansion when cleared. data-variant="lines" draws indent guides; an icon part draws a folder (open while expanded) or a file. data-draggable="true" moves items by pointer or by keyboard (Alt+Enter, arrows, Enter, Escape) with a drop indicator and announcements, and fires the cancelable faqir:move. The new item states are loading, error and grabbed. Markup that follows the 1.0 template is unchanged: single mode, same ARIA, same events.

Nested components keep their own parts. The stylesheet reached items, labels, toggles and groups with descendant selectors, so a component in an item's label with parts of those names (a chip's label) took the tree's. A tree's items recurse to any depth, which child combinators cannot express, so each rule keeps one descendant step, from the root to an item or group, and everything below it is a child hop: an item is the root's or a group's child, a label and a group an item's, a toggle a label's. The hops are in :where(), so no rule changes specificity. No change for markup that follows the template.

item.description: Tree node with role=treeitem, roving tabindex, selection or check state, and explicit aria-level/setsize/posinset

label.description: Visible accessible label and pointer-selection target for an item; holds the toggle, checkbox and icon

toggle.description: Decorative disclosure indicator; clicking it toggles a parent item

group.description: Nested role=group owned by a parent treeitem; hidden while the parent is collapsed

icon.description: Decorative (aria-hidden) glyph in a label after the toggle: a folder for a parent, open while expanded, a file for a leaf, an alert when a lazy load failed. Add data-ui="icon" data-icon="…" to use any icon instead

checkbox.description: Decorative (aria-hidden) box drawing the item's aria-checked in checkbox mode: a tick when true, a dash when mixed. The controller inserts one after the toggle when it is missing

spinner.description: data-ui="spinner" the controller appends to a lazy item's label while its children load (aria-hidden; the item carries aria-busy)

retry.description: Pointer button the controller appends to a lazy item whose load failed; expanding the item again (Right Arrow) retries too, which is what the announcement tells keyboard users

tree.description: Wrapper form only: the role=tree list, when the root is a wrapper that also holds a filter, an empty message and a status region

filter.description: Wrapper form: a search input (compose data-ui="input", give it an accessible name) that filters the tree as it is typed in; Down Arrow moves into the tree, Escape clears it

status.description: Wrapper form: a role=status region, visually hidden, that announces filter counts, loads and moves. Created when missing; a list root gets a visually-hidden sibling instead

empty.description: Wrapper form: the message shown (un-hidden) while a filter matches nothing

drop-indicator.description: aria-hidden element the controller places while dragging: a line before or after the target row, a ring around it for inside

selected.description: At least one item is selected (or checked, in checkbox mode)

loading.description: A lazy item whose children are being loaded; it also carries aria-busy="true" and a spinner part

error.description: A lazy item whose load failed; collapsed, with a retry part, until it is expanded again

grabbed.description: The item being moved, by pointer drag or after Alt+Enter, drawn dimmed until it drops or the move is cancelled

before.description: The drop lands before the target row

after.description: The drop lands after the target (and its subtree)

inside.description: The drop lands inside the target parent, as its last child

methods.name: select
methods.description: Select one item, replacing the selection; in checkbox mode, check it.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expand a parent item; an unloaded lazy item starts loading its children.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Expand a collapsed parent or collapse an expanded one.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Check or uncheck an item and every enabled item under it, then derive its ancestors (checkbox mode).

methods.name: selectAll
methods.description: Select every visible enabled item (multiple mode), or check them all (checkbox mode).

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Show only items whose label contains `query` (case-insensitive), with their ancestors expanded, and announce the count.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Load a lazy item's children now — what expanding it does.

methods.name: setLoader
methods.description: Register the function that loads a lazy item's children: it receives `{ item, value, label, attempt }` and returns (a Promise of) an array of `{ label, value, lazy, disabled, checked, children }`, item elements or markup.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Move an item before or after another, or inside a parent (as its last child), then renumber levels and positions.

methods.name: getSelected
methods.description: The selected item (single and multiple mode), or null.

methods.name: getSelection
methods.description: Every selected item, or every checked item in checkbox mode, in tree order.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove every listener, the observer and the timers, and end any drag.

value.description: On an item: its identity, used by select()/expand()/getSelected(). Falls back to the element id, then to its label text.

lazy.description: On an item: its children are loaded on first expand rather than present in the markup. Expanding it fires faqir:expand (lazy: true) and then faqir:load; children appended by either listener, by detail.respond(), by setLoader() or by a later render end the load.

mode.description: On the root: single selection (aria-selected on one item), multiple selection (aria-multiselectable, aria-selected on many), or tri-state checkboxes (aria-checked true/false/mixed, propagating down to enabled descendants and up to ancestors).

draggable.description: On the root: items can be moved — dragged with a pointer, or picked up with Alt+Enter, placed with Up/Down and dropped with Enter. A leaf accepts before/after; a parent also accepts inside. Every move fires the cancelable faqir:move.

required_attrs: role="tree" on root, or on the tree part when the root is a wrapper
aria-multiselectable on the tree: "false" in single mode, "true" in multiple and checkbox mode
aria-checked on every item in checkbox mode

keyboard.ArrowDown: move focus to the next visible enabled item without wrapping (multiple mode: Shift extends the selection from the anchor)
keyboard.ArrowUp: move focus to the previous visible enabled item without wrapping (multiple mode: Shift extends the selection from the anchor)
keyboard.ArrowRight: expand a collapsed parent (a lazy one starts loading, or retries after a failure), or move from an expanded parent to its first enabled child
keyboard.ArrowLeft: collapse an expanded parent, or move from a collapsed/leaf child to its enabled parent
keyboard.Home: move focus to the first visible enabled item (multiple mode: Ctrl+Shift+Home also selects up to it)
keyboard.End: move focus to the last visible enabled item (multiple mode: Ctrl+Shift+End also selects down to it)
keyboard.Enter: select the focused item; checkbox mode: toggle its check
keyboard.Space: select the focused item; multiple mode: toggle it in the selection (Shift+Space selects the range from the anchor); checkbox mode: toggle its check
keyboard.Ctrl+A: multiple mode: select every visible item; checkbox mode: check them
keyboard.Printable characters: move focus by case-insensitive typeahead with a 500ms buffer
keyboard.*: expand every enabled parent at the focused item's sibling level
keyboard.Alt+Enter: data-draggable: pick up the focused item to move it
keyboard.ArrowUp / ArrowDown (while moving): choose the previous or next place it can go — before, inside or after a row — announced with its level
keyboard.Home / End (while moving): choose the first or last place
keyboard.Enter / Space (while moving): drop it at the chosen place
keyboard.Escape / Tab (while moving): cancel the move; it stays where it was
keyboard.ArrowDown (in the filter): move focus into the first visible item
keyboard.Escape (in the filter): clear the filter and restore the expansion from before it

notes: Only parent and data-lazy items expose aria-expanded; leaf items must not carry it.
The controller computes aria-level, aria-setsize, and aria-posinset after every keyed DOM reconciliation and every move.
DOM focus and aria-selected remain distinct until Enter, Space, or pointer selection.
Items with aria-disabled=true are omitted from the roving focus order and cannot be selected, checked or moved; in checkbox mode they keep their state when a parent is toggled.
Checkbox mode uses aria-checked instead of aria-selected, never both; the checkbox part is aria-hidden because the treeitem itself carries the state.
A lazy item is aria-busy while it loads; the status region announces loading, the number of items loaded, and a failure with the key that retries.

Filtering announces the number of matches politely once typing pauses; the match is highlighted with the CSS Custom Highlight API, so no label text is rewritten (no highlight where the API is missing).
Every step of a keyboard move is announced (the place and its level), as are the drop and a cancel; a pointer drop announces where the item went.

Filter, status and empty message cannot live inside a role=tree list, so they need the wrapper form: a root holding the tree part. A list root that announces gets a visually-hidden role=status sibling.

faqir:select.detail: { item, value, label, previousItem, previousValue, items, values }
faqir:select.description: Fires after click, Enter, Space, a range or select() changes the selection; items/values list the whole selection (one item in single mode)

faqir:check.detail: { item, value, label, checked, items, values }
faqir:check.description: Checkbox mode: fires after an item (and its subtree) is checked or unchecked; items/values list every fully checked item

faqir:expand.description: Fires whenever a parent opens or closes; an app or l-source listener can provide children when expanded and lazy are true

faqir:load.description: A lazy item needs its children. Call respond() with an array of { label, value, lazy, disabled, checked, children }, item elements or markup — or a Promise of one; a rejected Promise shows the error state

faqir:loaded.description: A load finished: count children inserted, or error (null on success)

faqir:filter.description: The filter changed; count items match

faqir:move.detail: { item, value, label, target, targetValue, position, parent, parentValue, index }
faqir:move.description: Cancelable. Fires before an item moves — position is before, after or inside the target; parent and index say where it will sit. preventDefault() keeps it in place
